title: Bible Overlap Network Analysis Method — Bridges, Communities & Indispensable Periphery
purpose: Analyze the overlap corpus as a typed network rather than only a list. Separate frequency from bridge importance, structural dependence, community membership, role fidelity and ethical significance.

research_basis.use: Betweenness asks how often a node lies on shortest paths; useful as a descriptive bridge metric.
Articulation points identify nodes whose removal disconnects a graph; useful for structural bottlenecks.
Modularity-based community detection can expose motif neighborhoods without preassigning them.

research_basis.source: Network analysis has been applied to biblical textual corpora
research_basis.use: Methodological precedent for graph/community/centrality analysis of biblical textual structure; not validation of this project's theology.

graph_model.primary_graph: bipartite overlap↔biblical-reference, projected into book/operator/motif views only for explicitly declared analytical questions

metrics.question: What appears most often?
metrics.warning: High degree can result from broad/general vocabulary or repeated borrowing.

metrics.question: Which passage/book/operator connects otherwise separate clusters?
metrics.project_analogy: A Door can be modeled as a bridge-like function, but a high-betweenness node is not literally the Son or a metaphysical Door.

metrics.question: Which node is a structural bottleneck in this particular graph representation?
metrics.warning: A cut vertex may be an artifact of how nodes/edges were encoded; it is not theological necessity.

metrics.question: Which relations naturally cluster together under modularity/community detection?
metrics.warning: A computational cluster is a descriptive grouping, not a hidden biblical doctrine.

metrics.question: Which coherent passage holds several distinct roles/functions together?
metrics.example: John 10 combines Door/Gate, Shepherd, voice/recognition, entry/exit, pasture, protection and laying-down-life.

metrics.question: Which text connects House, Garden, Body, City, Tree, Gate or other project families that otherwise live in separate neighborhoods?
Which low-frequency or peripheral nodes carry a decisive correction, ethical constraint or role distinction?
metrics.biblical_neighbor: 1 Corinthians 12:12-27 explicitly warns that apparently weaker members can be indispensable.

anti_centrality_principle: Graph centrality is descriptive, not moral, theological or evidentiary worth. A rare countertext can be more important for integrity than a highly connected motif. The reader should therefore expose both central bridges and low-degree indispensable constraints.
do_not_compute: Do not convert centrality into probability of prophecy/divinity.
Do not interpret community detection as divine authorship or hidden-code proof.
Do not multiply evidence by projecting one overlap node into several graph layers and recounting it.
Do not hide negative/countertext nodes because they lower apparent cohesion.
Do not assume shortest-path geometry corresponds to historical transmission.
